steps.help: Step 1 of 7: Click the "Create Template" button to start building a new form template.
Step 2 of 7: Give your template a clear, descriptive name and add a description explaining its purpose. This helps users understand what the form is for.
Step 3 of 7: Sections organize your form into logical groups. Add a section for each topic or category of questions.
Step 4 of 7: Give each section a title and optional description. You can also set visibility conditions and permissions.
Step 5 of 7: Add form items like text fields, numbers, dropdowns, and more. Link items to indicators from the Indicator Bank for standardized data collection.
Step 6 of 7: Set the label, field type, validation rules, and link to an indicator if applicable. Required fields must be filled by users.
Step 7 of 7: Review your template structure in the preview, then click "Save Template" to create it. You can edit the template later if needed.
